dedupe_keys.name: production annuelle de biomethane par site d injection depuis 2013

description: Production annuelle de biométhane par site d'injection (depuis 2013) is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. Ce jeu de données permet de visualiser l’évolution année par année depuis 2013 des installations d’injection de biométhane raccordées au réseau de distribution de GRDF, leurs capacités d’injection, la localisation de leur lieu d’injection ainsi que la quantité annuelle injectée. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Production et stockage. Its keywords are territoires, gaz renouvelable, production, gaz. The portal shows 2025-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
